summary: P0 bug fixes testing for S.T.E.W.A.R.D. Dashboard trash and restore functionality. All 4 bugs verified as WORKING: Process delete, Goal delete, People restore (no duplicates), and Trash filters (new types visible).
critical_code_review_comments: ProcessesModule.jsx (lines 145-164): deleteProcess correctly calls addToTrash with TRASH_TYPES.PROCESS before removing from state
GoalsModule.jsx (lines 137-152): deleteGoal correctly calls addToTrash with TRASH_TYPES.GOAL before removing from state
PeopleModule.jsx (lines 49-75): Event listener for steward-people-updated correctly reloads people from localStorage
TrashModule.jsx (lines 230-260): handleRestore for TRASH_TYPES.GOAL properly checks for duplicates using goalExists before adding
TrashModule.jsx (lines 261-289): handleRestore for TRASH_TYPES.PROCESS properly checks for duplicates using processExists before adding
TrashModule.jsx (lines 193-222): handleRestore for TRASH_TYPES.PERSON properly checks for duplicates using personExists before adding
TrashModule.jsx (lines 390-399): All new filters visible - Cíle, Procesy, Grafy, Časy, Hudba
TrashContext.js (lines 15-27): TRASH_TYPES includes all new types: GOAL, PROCESS, MUSIC, CHART, TIMER
TrashContext.js (lines 190-204): getTrashStats includes stats for goals, processes, charts, timers, music
seed_data_creation: Used default seed data from localStorage initialization
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 bugs from the request have been verified fixed. The trash pipeline correctly handles: 1) Process delete with type 'process', 2) Goal delete with type 'goal', 3) People restore with duplicate check, 4) New trash filters (Cíle, Procesy, Grafy, Časy, Hudba) are visible in 'Smazaný obsah' mode.

bugs_tested.bug: Process delete - po smazání procesu by měl zmizet z modulu Procesy a objevit se v koši pod filtrem 'Procesy'
bugs_tested.details: Process 'Onboarding nového zákazníka' was deleted, removed from Processes module, and appeared in Trash with type='process'. Filter 'Procesy (1)' showed correct count.

bugs_tested.bug: Goal delete - po smazání cíle by měl zmizet z modulu Cíle a objevit se v koši pod filtrem 'Cíle'
bugs_tested.details: Goal 'Expandovat na nové trhy' was deleted, removed from Goals module, and appeared in Trash with type='goal'. Toast showed 'Cíl přesunut do koše'.

bugs_tested.bug: People restore - obnovení osoby z koše by nemělo vytvořit duplicitu v modulu Lidi
bugs_tested.details: Person 'Jan Novák' was deleted (4->3 people), restored from trash (3->4 people), and no duplicates were created. ID uniqueness verified.

bugs_tested.bug: Trash filters - ověřit, že nové filtry (Cíle, Procesy, Grafy, Časy, Hudba) se zobrazují ve 'Smazaný obsah' režimu
bugs_tested.details: All filters visible in Trash module: Vše, Poznámky, Projekty, Lidí, Úkoly, Cíle, Procesy, Grafy, Časy, Hudba

mocked_apis_note: Entire app uses localStorage for persistence - no backend API calls. Key: steward_trash_items for trash data
